speaker: Doctor
text: The patient's repetitive denial of chest pain and palpitations isn't providing new information about the cough's etiology. speaker: Doctor
text: The normal chest X-ray rules out pneumonia and significant heart failure, which makes an ACE-inhibitor cough or post-infectious cough more likely given the history of enalapril use and recent URI. speaker: Doctor
text: I am noting your denial of chest pain and palpitations. To distinguish between an ACE-inhibitor cough and post-infectious cough, please confirm if the dry, tickling cough began specifically after starting enalapril or if it started only after your recent upper respiratory infection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the patient's history of enalapril use, the chronic dry cough, and the exclusion of other causes via normal chest X-ray and lack of heart failure signs, the clinical picture is classic for an adverse drug reaction. DIAGNOSIS READY: ACE-inhibitor induced cough
